tasks.text: You want to start putting 500 ₪ a month into the S&P 500, with nothing put in at the start. A friend sent you these screenshots of a website, already set to 500 ₪ a month and nothing at the start. From them, find where it is cheapest to do this, and how much you would have after ten years.

where.description: Where you would do it: the bank or company, as the page names it

amount_after_10_years.description: How much you would have after ten years, in shekels; null if you did not find it

answerKey.partly: Psagot with another amount, or about 72,100 ₪ with another account
